overall_notes: This paper is primarily about salience detection in narratives (a text understanding task), not NLG. While it mentions potential downstream NLG applications like summarization and story generation, it does not actually evaluate any generation tasks. The automatic metrics are used to evaluate salience detection performance, not generated text quality.
